description.value: Kam Do Bakery is a beloved Chinese bakery in Richmond serving freshly made pastries, savory buns, egg tarts, and traditional baked goods to a steady stream of neighbours and visitors. Located in a mall unit steps from a busy bus stop, it has earned a 4.1/5 rating across over 1,200 reviews and is regarded as one of the best Chinese bakeries in the area. A touring cyclist could stop here for a quick, filling snack—generous fillings and individual wrapping make the buns easy to take on the road.

address.value: 6211 No. 3 Rd Unit 130, Richmond, BC V6Y 0C2

Reviews and the description confirm hot savory baked goods (chicken bun, sausage bun with cheese, ham and garlic bread) are available onsite. Neither bike parking nor water refill is mentioned anywhere.
